actors.reason: The Shadow Temple ferry, a platform (ACTORCAT_BG, line 40) with no collider or health. Once it has sunk more than 500 units with Link still aboard, it voids him out (Play_TriggerVoidOut, this line), the respawn path that costs one heart (Player_InflictDamage(play, -16), src/overlays/actors/ovl_player_actor/z_player.c:4824, armed at z_player.c:10743). That is a fall from scenery, not a combatant, which the contract puts out of scope.

Sliding climbable brick wall (Spirit Temple). While Link climbs it (stateFlags1 == PLAYER_STATE1_21 with a wall poly, z_bg_jya_zurerukabe.c:95), a moving section knocks him off with Actor_SetPlayerKnockbackLarge whose damage argument is 0 (z_bg_jya_zurerukabe.c:112, 118). The call adds no damage (knockbackDamage, src/code/z_actor.c:1976), so it costs Link no health. It has no collider and no health, so Link cannot hurt it. A climbing obstacle, not combat.

The doors of the Dampé race (ACTORCAT_BG, line 43), with no collider or health. When its countdown reaches zero outside a cutscene it voids Link out (Play_TriggerRespawn, this line), the respawn path that costs one heart (Player_InflictDamage(play, -16), src/overlays/actors/ovl_player_actor/z_player.c:4824, armed at z_player.c:10743). That is an environmental timer, which the contract puts out of scope.

Ganon's Lair rubble fragment for the castle-collapse cutscene (header, z_demo_geff.c:4). Its only update action, func_80978308 (z_demo_geff.c:179), finds the Demo_Gt it belongs to and copies that actor's position plus an offset (z_demo_geff.c:173); the other action only sets scale and the draw mode. The file declares no collider, no damage table, and no health, and calls nothing that hurts Link, so Link cannot hurt it and it cannot hurt Link. Category BOSS only because it is cutscene scenery of the Ganon fight.

NPC (graveyard kid, per its animation names). Its only collider is AC_NONE with ACELEM_NONE and ATELEM_NONE, never changed at runtime, and is registered only with CollisionCheck_SetOC (z_en_cs.c:450), so no Link attack reaches its all-zero damage table (z_en_cs.c:67) and it has nothing that hurts Link.

The Ganon's Tower collapse escape timer (ACTORCAT_ITEMACTION, line 37), with no collider or health. When the escape sub-timer runs out with switch 0x36 set, it voids Link out (Play_TriggerRespawn, this line), the respawn path that costs one heart (Player_InflictDamage(play, -16), src/overlays/actors/ovl_player_actor/z_player.c:4824, armed at z_player.c:10743). That is an environmental timer, which the contract puts out of scope.

Ganondorf's cape (header, z_en_ganon_mant.c:4), a cloth simulation drawn on Ganondorf. EnGanonMant_Update only counts down attach timers, copies Ganondorf's facing (z_en_ganon_mant.c:389), and tears the cloth (z_en_ganon_mant.c:393). The file declares no collider, no damage table, and no health, and calls nothing that hurts Link, so it neither hurts nor can be hurt. Ganondorf's own fight is modeled under Boss_Ganon.

The organ, carpet, and scenery Ganondorf plays in the cutscene before his fight (header, z_en_ganon_organ.c:4). EnGanonOrgan_Update does nothing but kill the actor once Ganondorf's organAlpha reaches 0 (z_en_ganon_organ.c:143-144); the rest of the file builds display lists. It declares no collider, no damage table, and no health, and calls nothing that hurts Link.

NPC (white-clothed Gerudo: gate guard, archery host, gate operator). Neither direct-hurt line harms Link: freezeTimer = 1200 on Link (z_en_ge1.c:607) and his horse (z_en_ge1.c:610) holds them while the archery game starts a scene transition (z_en_ge1.c:598-601). Spotting Link (EnGe1_SpotPlayer, z_en_ge1.c:259-264) starts a cutscene and EnGe1_KickPlayer sends Link to another entrance (z_en_ge1.c:244-254) with no damage. It has no AT, no health, and no damage table, and its AC is enemy-aligned (AC_ON | AC_TYPE_ENEMY, z_en_ge1.c:74), which Link's player-aligned attacks never match (src/code/z_collision_check.c:2677); an AC hit only triggers the same spotting (z_en_ge1.c:274, 317).

Gossip Stone prop. Its collider is AT_NONE (z_en_gs.c:54), so it never hurts Link, and every damage-table entry is 0 damage with no health (z_en_gs.c:71). A hit only picks a scripted reaction in this switch: a text box (0xF), a wobble (0xE), a squash (0xD), a spin (0xB), or for explosives a countdown and rocket launch that ends in Actor_Kill with a visual-only EffectSsBomb2 (0xC, z_en_gs.c:388-401). None of these changes anything combat-relevant.

Epona and the ranch horses. The only AT collider is player-aligned (AT_TYPE_PLAYER, z_en_horse.c:113; turned on above speed 5 at z_en_horse.c:3610), and an AT hits an AC only when they share an alignment bit (src/code/z_collision_check.c:2677), while Link takes only enemy-aligned hits (AC_ON | AC_TYPE_ENEMY, src/overlays/actors/ovl_player_actor/z_player.c:10470), so the trample hurts enemies, never Link. The AC sphere is ACELEM_NO_DAMAGE (z_en_horse.c:157) and a hit only plays a neigh (z_en_horse.c:3543-3547); the 10 health (z_en_horse.c:177) is never decremented, so Link cannot hurt the horse. Link riding the horse is out of scope.

NPC (Ingo). Its collider is AC_NONE (z_en_in.c:64) with no AT and is registered only with CollisionCheck_SetOC (z_en_in.c:958); it has no damage table (NULL at z_en_in.c:553). Every direct-hurt line is a cutscene hold, not harm: freezeTimer = 10 on Link and his horse at z_en_in.c:505/507 runs while Ingo opens a textbox, letterboxes, and hides the HUD (z_en_in.c:498-510), and again at z_en_in.c:841/843 (EnIn_ClosingGate) and z_en_in.c:927/929 (EnIn_EndRentalPeriod), each refreshing a 10-frame freeze during dialogue. No damage, knockback, or health change is applied.
